findings.message: The entry params listaId, responsavelId, prioridade, status, prazoDe, prazoAte, venceHoje and atrasada have effect filter:tarefasEquipe but no state holds them. Added one persisted public state per param (same id as the param), applied from URL/localStorage, sent in the listarTarefasEquipe input, and changed through listarTarefasEquipe(change).

reatribuirTarefa needs the new responsible typed/chosen by the person but the defs have no <command>.input state. Added the reatribuirTarefaDraft state with its setter setReatribuirTarefaDraft; id and version come from the open task.

selectedTarefa (entry.params.tarefaId) has no setter; selecting is served by the request method obterTarefa(tarefaId | null), which publishes selectedTarefa and fetches the record into tarefa (null clears both).

reatribuirTarefa and cancelarTarefa return a TarefaDetalhe while the board rows are TarefaEquipeItem. Only the fields both share (titulo, status, prioridade, prazo, responsavelId, responsavel) are copied into the row; the row's computed indicators (details.venceHoje, details.atrasada, progressoChecklist) stay as loaded until the next listarTarefasEquipe, e.g. a cancelled task may keep its overdue signal. Rows that no longer match the status/responsavelId/due-signal filters are removed.
